import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    original=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual==expected, (name,actual,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==original, name
    assert set(actual)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}, name

check('missing calibration', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [], {'required_conditions':['recipe','calibration']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
check('only eligible may supersede', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'X'},'supersedes':['A']}], {'required_conditions':['recipe']}, {'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['A'],'unknowns':[]})
check('withdrawn and verification', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'verified':False}], {'required_conditions':['recipe'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('canonical object agreement', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [{'source':'Z','claim':'c','value':{'x':[1,2],'y':False},'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}},{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':{'y':False,'x':[1,2]},'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}], {'required_conditions':['recipe']}, {'status':'supported','value':{'x':[1,2],'y':False},'sources':['A','Z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('false unsupported after supersession', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':True,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'}},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'recipe':'R'},'supersedes':'A'}], {'required_conditions':['recipe']}, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['B'],'unknowns':[]})
print('5 boundary cases passed')
